M-SOURCE-GENERATORS-COMMON.Purpose: Shared infrastructure of all FlexVerse source generators: the incremental generator entry point and common code-building, Roslyn and string utilities used by every generator pipeline stage.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: FlexVerseGenerator: incremental generator entry dispatching generator pipelines.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: RoslynUtils and StringUtils: shared analysis/emission helpers.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Widget pipeline stages — owned by M-REACTIVITY-ANALYZER, M-WIDGET-MODELS and M-WIDGET-EMITTER.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: FlexVerseProperty ([FVP]) generator pipeline — owned by M-FLEXVERSE-PROPERTY.

Principles.PRIN-001: Shared utilities carry no widget- or property-specific semantics; they are generic over pipelines.

Requirements.REQ-001: Adding a generator pipeline requires no changes to shared utilities.

Inputs.IN-001: Roslyn incremental generation context and type symbols supplied by generator pipelines.

Outputs.OUT-001: Registered pipeline outputs and source text assembled through shared utilities.

SideEffects.EFF-001: FlexVerseGenerator adds generated sources and reports pipeline diagnostics to the compilation.
